Regulation: B.C. Reg. 128/2026
Made under: Coastal Ferry Act
Published in: No. 14 – B.C. Regs. 125 to 148, July 28, 2026
Deposit date: July 17, 2026

B.C. Reg. 128/2026, deposited July 17, 2026, under theCOASTAL FERRY ACT[sections 30 and 76]. Order in Council 337/2026, approved and ordered July 17, 2026. On the recommendation of the undersigned, the Lieutenant Governor, by and with the advice and consent of the Executive Council, orders that Schedule A to the Designation Regulation, B.C. Reg. 109/2003, is amended by repealing page A9.1 and substituting the attached page A9.1. — M. FARNWORTH,Minister of Transportation and Transit; R. PARMAR,Presiding Member of the Executive Council. minutes_briefs.title: BC Ferries Route Designation Regulation Updated by Order in Council
minutes_briefs.summary: B.C. Reg. 128/2026, deposited July 17, 2026, amends Schedule A of the Designation Regulation under the Coastal Ferry Act by replacing page A9.1. This changes which ferry routes are designated under the Act, which affects how ferry services are regulated.
